from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracts the citation relationships found within a single provided paper."""
    source_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the current paper being analyzed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    paper_records: list[PaperCitationRecord]
